reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonBusinessDay predicate that every holiday-aware path (getNextDate, the weekend shift, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) already uses.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is a single added comparison in the shared predicate.

placement.why: The holiday rule changes in shared/schedules.ts where the business-day definition already lives.

scope.why: A three-line change plus two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Minimal and central; day.slice(5) encodes the MM-DD format implicitly and would read better as a named helper or comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks route through isNonBusinessDay.
